why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Get a referral code Action Model is invite only. The project points people to its Discord and Telegram to find a code, and says community members also share theirs on X.
2 Step 2 : Register on the training site Create your account on the Action Model sign-up page , using a referral code from step 1 if the form asks for one.
3 Step 3 : Install the browser extension Add the extension from the Chrome Web Store listing . The project says it is also installable in other browsers.
4 Step 4 : Train the model Switch the extension on while you browse. Its training settings let you block websites or traffic types and pause training at any time.
5 Step 5 : Add ActionFi tasks, quests and referrals Complete partner tasks through ActionFi , join quests and invite others with your own referrals to add to your LAM Points.
6 Step 6 : Follow official updates The project says LAM Points are intended to convert to LAM at the Token Generation Event and that updates will appear on its dashboard and community channels.
